title: The public Calendar tab shows the guest calendar to everyone, with one link to the team calendar

source.ref: Plans and calendar clarity audit 2026-11-25 (project thread: Audit the project and calendar system; doc https://claude.ai/artifact/GUTHmChGkqaEmPSRUdzJHz)

detail:
FOUND 2026-11-25: a Space's team sees two different team calendars. The public tab (/spaces/<slug>/calendar) renders CalendarWorkspace with the older StaffCalendar (Workflow and List), and the console renders CalendarSuite. They share data but not behaviour, so a team member learns two tools. Fix: the tab is the guest calendar for everyone plus an 'Open team calendar' button to the console; StaffCalendar leaves the tab. Reverses the 2026-10-29 ruling that kept team tools on the tab. Supersedes the 2026-10-29 ruling that kept team tools on the tab.

The public Calendar tab is one guest calendar for every viewer, the team included, with an Open team calendar button to /spaces/<slug>/settings/calendar for a viewer who may run the Space's events. The tab no longer loads the team records or mounts the staff grid, List, Workflow, console, Vera box or Plan drawer; an old operator deep link (?view=, ?plan=, ?item=, ?console=, ?look=) is sent on to the team calendar. 19 done-row probes that read the old team mode were rewritten into scripts/probes/public-calendar-tab.mjs (owner approved 2026-11-27).

verify.note: Passes while the public Calendar tab carries no second team calendar (no StaffCalendar). The tab's own shape is measured by scripts/probes/public-calendar-tab.mjs.
